abstract: To elucidate the involvement of type IV collagenases [matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)-2 and MMP-9] and their tissue inhibitors (TIMP-1 and TIMP-2) in the development of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), we quantified their levels in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma tissues using specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, and the results were compared with those from normal first trimester placenta. Levels of pro-MMP-2 were increased in hydatidiform mole, and they were further elevated in choriocarcinoma. Levels of pro-MMP-9 in choriocarcinoma and those of TIMP-1 in both hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma were also increased. In contrast, TIMP-2 levels were markedly decreased in both hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma. Similar results were obtained by the tissue culture of first trimester placenta and hydatidiform mole. Gelatin zymography indicated that the levels of both pro- and activated forms of MMP-2 and MMP-9 were higher in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma. The decreased expression of TIMP-2 in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma was confirmed by Western blot, Northern blot and immunohistochemistry, with the decrease being more pronounced in choriocarcinoma. Taken together, the present study shows that both TIMP-2 mRNA and protein levels are markedly decreased in GTD and the imbalance of MMP-TIMP production, shifted toward greater MMP activity, may be involved in the pathogenesis of GTD.
abstract_ja:
目的:IV型コラゲナーゼ[マトリックスメタロプロテアーゼ(MMP)-2およびMMP-9]とその組織阻害因子(TIMP-1およびTIMP-2)が妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の発症に関与するかを検討するため、胞状奇胎および絨毛癌組織におけるそれらの量を特異的酵素免疫測定法で定量し、正常な妊娠初期胎盤と比較した。
結果:pro-MMP-2は胞状奇胎で上昇し、絨毛癌ではさらに上昇した。絨毛癌ではpro-MMP-9も上昇し、TIMP-1は胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の両方で上昇していた。一方、TIMP-2は胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の両方で著明に低下していた。妊娠初期胎盤および胞状奇胎の組織培養でも同様の結果が得られた。ゼラチンザイモグラフィーでは、MMP-2およびMMP-9の前駆体型と活性型の両方のレベルが胞状奇胎と絨毛癌で高かった。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌におけるTIMP-2の低下は、ウエスタンブロット、ノーザンブロット、免疫組織化学でも確認され、低下は絨毛癌でより顕著であった。
結論:本研究は、GTDではTIMP-2のmRNAとタンパク質の両方のレベルが著明に低下しており、MMP産生の不均衡がMMP活性の亢進へ傾いていることがGTDの病態形成に関与している可能性を示している。
